tools.name: search_company
tools.description: Look up which SEC-registered company a name, ticker or CIK refers to. Returns up to 10 candidates, each with its CIK, tickers and a match score, and nothing else. Use it to pick the right CIK when a name is ambiguous, then call company_profile with that CIK for the details.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Full SEC EDGAR record for one company, given its CIK, ticker or name (best match): legal name, industry (SIC), state of incorporation, business address, 3 fiscal years of revenue, net income, total assets and cash, and its recent 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings with links. Use search_company first if you

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Fuzzy-screen a person or organisation name against OFAC SDN + Consolidated, UN, EU, and UK sanctions lists. Returns up to 15 scored matches with source links; if more match, the summary says so and suggests a more specific query. Optional dob/birth_year, nationality and country set aside same-name m

tools.name: domain_age
tools.description: Domain registration date, age, registrar (RDAP) and email-auth records (MX, SPF, DMARC), which are common fraud signals, plus first_archived: the date of the Wayback Machine's earliest snapshot (null if none; archive.status says unavailable if archive.org didn't answer). notes holds factual remarks,

tools.name: state_registry_link
tools.description: Official Secretary of State business-search link for a US state, to verify a private company's status, formation date, and registered agent.

tools.name: due_diligence_report
tools.description: One-call due-diligence report: SEC profile (if public), sanctions screen, federal exclusions, domain signals (registration age, email records, Wayback Machine first-seen date), and state registry link, with a red-flag summary, a verdict (clear / review / hold; rules at https://mcp.pyxmark.com/#verdi

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "state_registry_link" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Official Secretary of State business-search link for a US state, to verify a private company's status, formation date, and registered agent.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: due_diligence_report · Private data: company_profile, domain_age, state_registry_link, due_diligence_report · Public sink: screen_sanctions, domain_age, due_diligence_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: due_diligence_report · Private data: company_profile, domain_age, state_registry_link, due_diligence_report · Public sink: screen_sanctions, domain_age, due_diligence_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
